My passion for healthcare runs deep. I'm driven by the opportunity to make a real difference in people's lives through operational excellence, technological innovation, and a collaborative leadership style. 

I'm always looking for new ways to elevate performance, improve outcomes, and build stronger, more resilient healthcare organizations. Let's connect and explore how we can work together to transform healthcare delivery!
